eventDetail.scope: IEEE EDPS serves as a leading forum for thought leaders of the design community. Industry leaders discuss state-of-the-art improvements to the electronic design processes and CAD methodologies, emphasizing trends and new paradigms. IEEE EDPS focus will include Smart Design and Manufacturing (CAD/Test/Manufacturing tools), looking at new developments in systems approach to design and manufacturing, AI support and applications, advanced technologies, and the tools that support these. EDPS has always emphasized topical trends in electronics design and manufacturing, with special emphasis on methodology.
